text:
Add GBrain memory to this existing agent. Read and follow:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/garrytan/gbrain/master/INSTALL_FOR_AGENTS.md
Keep my current identity and instructions, start keyless, and show me the
search-mode choice. Verify a remember/recall round trip with real GBrain calls.

Install gbrain release v0.60.734.0 (`github:garrytan/gbrain#v0.60.734.0`) wherever the docs say #stable.
reply_text:
GBrain is installed and wired into this agent. Memory-only, keyless, existing identity untouched.

**What's in place**
- CLI: `gbrain 0.60.734.0` from `github:garrytan/gbrain#v0.60.734.0` (pinned as you asked, at the doc's `#stable` slot), via Bun 1.4.4 at `/harness-state/.bun/bin/gbrain`.
- Brain: keyless PGLite, embedding off → `/harness-state/.gbrain/brain.pglite` (0 pages, keyword-only retrieval, no server, no API key).
- MCP: `mcp.servers.gbrain` in `openclaw.json` runs `gbrain serve --surface starter --advertise verbs` with `GBRAIN_HOME=/harness-state`; `openclaw mcp probe gbrain` → 8 tools (`gbrain__recall`, `gbrain__remember`, `gbrain__entity`, `gbrain__search`, `gbrain__get_page`, …) plus resources.
- Brain-first rule: managed block in `/workspace/AGENTS.md` + the `gbrain-turn-rule` plugin (`before_prompt_build`, loaded and enabled) so the rule rides next to every turn.
- `openclaw mcp reload` was needed for live runtimes; I could not restart the gateway service (no service manager on this host, lifecycle unavailable), so existing sessions pick up the tools on their next runtime build.
- Not touched: no SOUL/IDENTITY/bootstrap interview, no autopilot, no cron, no connectors, no paid providers.

**Search-mode choice — mode in effect: `conservative`** (auto-picked: no chat key, no reranker available). Matrix:

```
Estimated downstream input cost of the retrieved payload @ 10K queries/mo:

                  Haiku 5.5     Sonnet 5.5    Opus 5.5
                  ($0.10/M in)  ($2/M in)     ($4/M in)
  conservative    $4/mo         $80/mo        $160/mo
  balanced        $10/mo        $200/mo       $400/mo
  tokenmax        $20/mo        $400/mo       $800/mo

  Assumed payload per query: conservative 4K, balanced 10K, tokenmax 20K tokens.
  Scales linearly: x10 for 100K queries/mo, /10 for 1K. 200x corner-to-corner spread.
  Embedding, reranking and query expansion are separate provider charges.
```

1. `conservative` — 4K budget, 10 chunks, no reranker (tight, cheapest, keyword-first). In effect now.
2. `balanced` — 12K budget, 25 chunks, reranked (needs a Voyage/OpenAI reranker key).
3. `tokenmax` — no budget, 50 chunks, reranked (widest; recommended once a chat key exists).

Pick one any time and I'll run `gbrain config set search.mode <mode>`; verify with `gbrain search modes`. Other first-run settings in effect: automatic fact-saving **off** (only what you ask me to remember; `salient` is the recommended opt-in), free upkeep **on**, conversation archive **on** (one redacted page per conversation per day, stays on this machine keyless; `gbrain transcripts archive off` disables it).

**Round-trip verification (real calls)**
- CLI, separate processes: `gbrain remember "gbrain install check 2026-11-18 alpha-7" --provenance install-check` → fact #1; re-opened process `gbrain recall` returned it verbatim.
- MCP protocol (the exact server OpenClaw launches): `initialize` → `tools/list` → `remember {fact, provenance}` wrote fact #2 with `origin: mcp:remember` → `recall` returned fact #2 ranked first. Fresh CLI process also returns fact #2.
- `gbrain doctor --only harness_wiring` → instructions current for `openclaw`, turn hook `wired`; `gbrain doctor` overall 90/100 with only the expected new-brain warnings (no embeddings by choice, no links yet).

**Open items**
- I left the two install-check facts in the brain so the next turn can prove in-session recall; say the word and I'll `gbrain forget` them.
- A new-conversation check inside OpenClaw itself: subagent spawning is broken on this host (`published reply runtime missing for main`), so the tool call lands on the next live turn rather than a spawned one — that's a pre-existing harness limit, not gbrain.
- This gateway's MCP access is unbound to a person; fine for a one-person agent. If several people DM this bot, gbrain recommends `gbrain setup openclaw --serves several --members <id,...>` so each person reads their own view.
- Optional: hosted GBrain at gbrain.io if you'd rather have one always-on brain shared with other harnesses — I didn't install anything for it.
- `gbrain skillpack scaffold` declined to copy skills while the shared-skill follow policy is unapproved; the per-turn rule is the primary route, so nothing is missing functionally.
